jet.en: He was photographed riding horses shirtless, diving into icy waters, and piloting fighter jets.
jet.zh: 镜头记录下他赤膊骑马、冬泳以及驾驶战斗机的画面。

jet.en: An example of those elements would be fast fashion, private jets, the beef and meat industry.
jet.zh: 这些要素的例子包括快时尚、私人飞机、牛肉和肉类产业。

jet.en: In the 1980s, he even reportedly had a Concorde jet pick him up for shopping trips in Europe.
jet.zh: 上世纪80年代，据传他甚至曾用协和飞机接送自己去欧洲购物。

jet.en: There are some obvious reasons. From the 1960s onwards, cheap flights and package holidays meant that British holidaymakers increasingly jetted off for the south of Spain rather than sitting on a windy beach in northern England.
jet.zh: 这其中有一些显而易见的原因。从 1960 年代起，廉价航班和包价旅游意味着英国度假者越来越多地坐飞机前往西班牙南部，而不是坐在英格兰北部风刮个不停的海滩上。

jealousy.en: Then there’s the idea of plain old jealousy and spite.
jealousy.zh: 还有一种观点认为是纯粹的嫉妒和恶意。

jealousy.en: This novel spends a lot of time talking about emotions and relationships, jealousy, romance, the inner lives of characters.
jealousy.zh: 这部小说花了很多时间讨论情感和人际关系、嫉妒、浪漫以及人物的内心世界。

jealousy.en: This was a psychological tactic. It created jealousy and mistrust among the prisoners, breaking down any sense of solidarity they might have had.
jealousy.zh: 这是一种心理战术，在囚犯之间制造了嫉妒和猜忌，瓦解了他们本可能拥有的团结感。

jewel.en: Hardy later said that reading Ramanujan’s work was like “opening a treasure chest full of mathematical jewels.”
jewel.zh: Hardy后来评价说，阅读Ramanujan的作品就像是“打开了一个装满数学珍宝的宝箱。”
